segments.caption: Three children run and joyfully dive into a large pile of autumn leaves in a grassy field, laughing and tumbling together as they play.
Three children are joyfully playing in a large pile of fallen autumn leaves in a grassy yard, energetically jumping and tossing leaves into the air.

In a residential yard blanketed with fallen leaves, three children are joyfully playing in a large pile, tossing leaves into the air and running around. A red pickup truck and a black car are parked in the driveway under a covered carport, with a house visible in the background. The scene captures a lively, carefree autumn afternoon.
Children play energetically in the leaf-strewn yard, running and kicking up fallen leaves, while an adult watches from the driveway near parked vehicles and two dogs.

A woman walks across a driveway toward a black car, while two young children play in the yard covered in fallen leaves. One child runs toward the house, and the other carries a pile of leaves across the lawn, suggesting a casual, autumnal day of yard play.

A young boy, barefoot and carrying a bundle of fallen leaves, walks across a leaf-strewn yard and driveway toward the front of a house. He tosses the leaves, scattering them across the concrete, as a little girl in a blue shirt joins him, also holding a handful of leaves and playfully throwing them into the air. The scene, set on an autumn day, captures children enjoying a simple, joyful outdoor activity in their suburban neighborhood.

In a suburban backyard covered in fallen autumn leaves, children are joyfully playing outdoors. The scene begins with a young girl in a blue shirt standing on the concrete driveway, interacting with a dog near a parked car. The camera then pans to a grassy yard where two other children, a boy in a dark shirt and a girl in pink pants, are running and playing through the leaves.
